title: Anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Anchor drawn in bright colours on Doot's dark screen -->
  <!-- Shank -->
  <rect x="44" y="28" width="12" height="44" rx="4" fill="#FF8A3D"/>
  <!-- Shank highlight -->
  <rect x="46" y="30" width="4" height="40" rx="2" fill="#FFC08A"/>
  <!-- Stock (crossbar) -->
  <rect x="30" y="24" width="40" height="10" rx="4" fill="#FFD24A"/>
  <rect x="32" y="26" width="36" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFF2B0"/>
  <!-- Ring at top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="20" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#63E6FF" stroke-width="5"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="20" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#B9F6FF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Arms / flukes -->
  <path d="M50 72 C50 88 32 90 24 78 C30 82 38 82 44 76 Z" fill="#7CF26B"/>
  <path d="M50 72 C50 88 68 90 76 78 C70 82 62 82 56 76 Z" fill="#7CF26B"/>
  <!-- Fluke tips lighter -->
  <path d="M24 78 C30 82 38 82 44 76" fill="none" stroke="#C9FFB8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M76 78 C70 82 62 82 56 76" fill="none" stroke="#C9FFB8" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Central bottom point -->
  <path d="M44 72 L50 88 L56 72 Z" fill="#FF6FB5"/>
</svg>
